user_clarification.work_dependency: The Phase-1 problem is to eliminate the Work-mode/protected-primary execution dependency itself. A purported irreducible handoff is not a solved route.
user_clarification.resource_dependency: A route relying on an exhaustible GitHub monthly free allowance, hosted compute, artifact/storage allowance, cloud/API trial or paid credit must not count as solved.

forbidden_solution_dependencies: GitHub Actions hosted-runner minutes or Actions-dependent compute
GitHub Actions artifacts, LFS, Packages or other quota-metered storage/transfer
paid or trial external API/model credits
manual user execution to bridge a missing Chat capability
repository_transport_boundary: Normal Git contents/ref/issue/PR operations may be used only as lightweight control/evidence transport and must tolerate per-window rate limits. They are not accepted as quota-backed compute.
bridge_change: Bridge now owns elimination of purported handoffs. Every residual becomes an unresolved problem-tree child and alternative-route search, never an accepted package.
exact_next_action: Optimizer, Integrator, Bridge, Reproducibility Auditor and Evidence Comparator build and test the Work-dependency-elimination matrix under zero-quota controls; keep Phase 1 open until every matrix row has no residual Work/protected-primary/user step and no finite-quota dependency.
